lastCompletedStory.title: Emit a structured event on every supervisor terminal

nextStoryContext: finishTerminal (runSupervisor, src/supervisor/loop.ts, defined once BEFORE the `outer: while` loop, not per-iteration) now unconditionally emits a `logEvent({ kind: 'sidecar-exit', storyId: lastIterProgress.currentStoryId, uuid: 'supervisor', detail: { reason: TERMINAL_REASON[status] } })` call ahead of teardownWorkerPaneFn, for every terminal (blocked/complete/awaiting-operator/max-iterations), guarded no-op when logEvent is absent (same pattern as the pre-existing emit()/emitTokens() helpers). uuid is a FIXED literal 'supervisor' (never a real worker session uuid) because finishTerminal has no per-story uuid in scope at its definition site; storyId is undefined on the complete/awaiting-operator terminals (action.kind isn't 'implement' there) -- both are intentional, not gaps, and are documented in the patterns.md bullet for this story. TERMINAL_REASON is a literal Record<SupervisorStatus,string> lookup (currently reason===status for all 4 members) rather than a status passthrough, per the story notes' explicit-mapping requirement; a future story that wants a differently-worded reason string only needs to edit this one lookup, not any call site. This story reused the existing 'sidecar-exit' WorkerEventKind (per the prior story's notes suggestion) rather than adding a new kind -- if a downstream story (e.g. a dashboard/event-log consumer) needs to distinguish a loop-level 'sidecar-exit'-from-finishTerminal event from the outer runSidecarLoop's plan/ship-crash or session-absent 'sidecar-exit' events, the discriminator today is uuid==='supervisor' (loop-level) vs uuid==='sidecar' (outer-loop self-exit) -- there is no separate kind or field yet. test/supervisor/events.test.ts's full-lifecycle sequence assertion (kinds array + uuid Set) now has an extra trailing 'sidecar-exit' entry and 'supervisor' uuid on every runSupervisor-driving test that reaches a terminal with logEvent wired -- any NEW full-sequence assertion test added in a future story must account for this trailing entry from the start, not discover it via a failing gate. This PRD's remaining scope (per prior handoffs) is US-005/US-006 (durable implement-blocked-marker half of the CAM-195 fix, independent of this story and of US-003/US-007).
